Yes, arriving to school on time is more likely than arriving to school late overall.

Here's the reasoning:

1. The probability of waking up late is 5%, which means the probability of waking up on time is 95%.
2. For days when Alice wakes up on time, the probability of arriving to school on time is 52%.
3. For days when Alice wakes up late, the probability of arriving to school on time is 87%.

To calculate the overall probability of arriving to school on time, we can use the following formula:

P(Arriving on time) = P(Waking up on time) * P(Arriving on time | Waking up on time) + P(Waking up late) * P(Arriving on time | Waking up late)

P(Arriving on time) = 0.95 * 0.52 + 0.05 * 0.87
